english:
Reaching Critical Health or healing an ally at Critical Health grants the following benefits to Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms for 11 seconds:
• 20 Range and Stability
• 30 Reload Speed with 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration

Healing a Critical Health ally with a Support Frame Auto Rifle after triggering Pleas Heard removes its healing effect, because healing requires firing.

source.text:
4 Piece | Magnificent Duty

Upon reaching Critical Health or healing an ally at Critical Health:

For Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms:
+20 Range, +20 Stability, +30 Reload Speed, and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for 11 seconds.

Using a Support Frame Auto to heal a Critical Health Ally after triggering the Pleas Heard effect removes the healing effect as it requires firing to heal... Bungie?
